messages:
Priya K.: FYI — Sunburst reported a latency spike after enabling the summarize endpoint during onboarding today. Saw 95th go from 220ms -> 720ms around 14:12 UTC.
Marco S.: Looking at traces: KV cache hit dropped from 78% -> 21% because prefix lengths changed. Most requests are short; we can try int8 quant + prefer small-model routing.
Priya K.: Customer is in pilot; renewal in 60 days. They flagged latency as top blocker for GA. Can we propose a quick canary? want to offer low-cost perf win.
Marco S.: Proposed plan: 1) Canary 5% traffic -> model-mix: 70% m7b-8q, 30% m13b-16q fallback 2) Enable prefix-based cache warmup for their route 3) Route by latency SLO to dedicated pool in us-west-2
Lina O.: SLO note: if we route to dedicated, need to ensure burst capacity configured for this account or we risk throttles. Also add fallback to hosted if dedicated health drops below 90%.
Ben C.: Priya — I can draft the customer note. Need to confirm: do we commit to 99% under 500ms or just a best-effort? Also flagging renewal risk if we don't show improvement within 2 weeks.
Marco S.: Implementation bits:
```yaml
rollout:
  percent: 5
  model_mix:
    - model: redwood/m7b
      quant: int8
      weight: 0.7
    - model: redwood/m13b
      quant: q16
      weight: 0.3
route_policy:
  primary: dedicated-usw2
  fallback: hosted
  cache_warmup: prefix
```

Marco S.: I'll file the canary and add a trace tag sunburst/onboard-canary. Lina, can you pre-allocate 2x burst capacity for the dedicated pool for 48h?
Lina O.: On it. Pre-alloc request submitted (ticket #INC-9081). Ops-bot: alloc reply pending from infra.
ops-bot: Pre-allocation request INC-9081 created by Lina O. ETA 2h.
Priya K.: Thanks — Ben, please send the customer note after Marco confirms rollout timing. I'll book a sync with Sunburst for Thursday to capture feedback and collect representative prompts.
Ben C.: Draft ready. Will include ask for 10 sample prompt patterns and permission to run A/B for 2 weeks. Sending now.
Marco S.: Canary scheduled 16:30 UTC. I'll monitor KV hit and latency, will post a short update in 30m and 2h.
Priya K.: Great. If 95th latency drops under 480ms we'll propose change as default and include ROI estimates for them (token cost delta and latency gain). :thumbsup: 
Ben C.: Noted — capturing this in renewal tracker under 'Sunburst — latency pilot'.
Marco S.: Update 30m: Canary in progress, initial 95th dropped to 490ms, KV hit up to 54%. Continuing.
Priya K.: Awesome. Will update customer. If we see regressions, revert to hosted immediately.
